import django
from django.conf import settings
settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth"],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD="django.db.models.AutoField",
)
django.setup()
from django.db import models, connection

class Category(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=20)
    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro"

class Post(models.Model):
    category = models.ForeignKey(Category, on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    title = models.CharField(max_length=20)
    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro"

with connection.schema_editor() as se:
    se.create_model(Category)
    se.create_model(Post)

cat = Category.objects.create(name="c1")
for i in range(5):
    Post.objects.create(category=cat, title=f"p{i}")

qs = Category.objects.prefetch_related(
    models.Prefetch("post_set", queryset=Post.objects.all()[:3], to_attr="example_posts")
)
cats = list(qs)
print("example_posts:", [p.title for p in cats[0].example_posts])
assert [p.title for p in cats[0].example_posts] == ["p0", "p1", "p2"]
print("REPRO OK")
EOF
